consequence.statement: After upgrading to 1.17 the metric formerly exposed as envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_failure is emitted as envoy_cilium_npds_update_failure, so dashboards, alerts, or other monitoring that select the old name will no longer match data for it.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alerts, and other monitoring that reference envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_failure to use envoy_cilium_npds_update_failure.

original.statement: Cilium 1.17 renames the metric envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_failure to envoy_cilium_npds_update_failure, so monitoring that references the old name no longer matches it.

decision.reason: [ev-9f3945740531] lists `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_failure` -> `envoy_cilium_npds_update_failure` under Changed Metrics. [ev-77f05428497a] says the whole NPDS metrics prefix "has been renamed" to `envoy_cilium_npds_`. A rename means the data is now emitted under the new name, so monitoring that queries the old name stops matching. Cilium itself keeps working, and the evidence names no failure, rejection or required migration, so behavior-change (a review item) with low severity is the right call. A failure kind would claim more than the evidence supports.
